description: Sanitized validation reporting contract, not an architectural comparator
rules: A source snapshot has tested_revision null even if a later commit matches its bytes.
Each command names its own source_id; precommit builds and exact-revision runtime are distinct.
Failed attempts remain separate immutable reports and retain their nonzero exits.
Expected refusal and panic classifications are distinct from failed required positives.
Ordered case IDs and counts must equal the suite's predeclared inventory.
Operational elapsed times are not performance benchmark measurements.
Raw paths, usernames, hostnames, mappings and full environment captures remain private.
Process-group runner cleanup is not ECHILD descendant proof.
Four preexisting workspace ignores are named explicitly; native capability skips are forbidden.
Claim 4 support from the Word subset is not complete claim 4 or complete A4. Claims 1-3 remain unqualified.
